title: Northgate Credit Cards Account Status Parameters
content:
Three settings of each Northgate Credit Cards product govern how the account behaves around its linked membership and its closure: the membership statuses in which the card works at Northgate, the number of calendar days a card may stay restricted before Meridian Trust Bank closes it, and whether rewards not yet issued are forfeited when the account closes.

## Status table

| Card product | Linked membership statuses in which the card works at Northgate | Calendar days a card may stay restricted before the bank closes it | Rewards not yet issued forfeited when the account closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | Active | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Store Card | Active | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Active | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Active | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Active | 90 | Yes |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | Active | 90 | Yes |

## Card account statuses referred to

A Northgate card account is in one of five statuses: applied (an application awaiting the bank's decision), active, restricted (the linked membership has stopped being active, so the card has stopped working at Northgate), declined (the bank declined the application) and closed.

## Reading the table

- **Working at Northgate.** On every product the single working status of the linked membership is active; a linked membership in any other status is outside the list.
- **Restriction period.** The figure is counted in calendar days, so weekends and holidays count like any other day. Hypothetical illustration: a card that has been restricted for 89 calendar days has not yet stayed restricted for 90; a card that has been restricted for 90 calendar days has.
- **Forfeiture on closure.** Yes on every product: when the account closes, rewards that have not yet been issued as a certificate are forfeited.
